title: 接地，给漏电找条路

points.K2: 接哪里：金属外壳与中性点
points.K4: 漏电和短路电流有处去
points.K5: 作用一：给漏电流开条路
points.K8: 作用四：泄放雷电和短路电流
points.K9: 作用五：电子设备工作更稳

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室配电箱旁，手里拿着一段黄绿色导线，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab distribution box holding a short green and yellow wire and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 你好！今天讲讲接地。

shots.scene: 接地符号、闪电、盾牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a ground symbol, a lightning bolt and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 它是什么，为什么非要不可？

shots.scene: 阿杰摸了一下烘箱的金属外壳，皱眉缩手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student touches the metal case of a lab oven, frowns and pulls his hand back.
shots.narration: 阿杰碰烘箱外壳，手有点发麻。

shots.scene: 老李检查烘箱后面，发现接地线松脱
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the back of the oven and finds a loose green and yellow ground wire.
shots.narration: 老李一查：接地线松了。

shots.scene: 老李贴上空白停用牌，欣欣走过来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer attaches a blank out of service tag to the oven as the panda mascot walks over.
shots.narration: 先停用修好。欣欣来讲讲为什么。

shots.scene: 设备外壳经一根导线连到地下接地极
shots.prompt_en: A metal equipment case connected by a wire to a ground rod buried in the earth. No people.
shots.narration: 接地，就是用电阻很小的导线，

shots.scene: 漏出的电沿导线快速流入大地
shots.prompt_en: Stray current flows quickly along the wire down into the earth. No people.
shots.narration: 把不该有的电，直接引进大地。

shots.section_title: 接哪里：金属外壳与中性点
shots.scene: 仪器金属外壳上的接地端子亮起
shots.prompt_en: The ground terminal on the metal case of a lab instrument lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 把设备不带电的金属部分接地，
overlay: 接哪里：金属外壳与中性点

shots.section_title: 接哪里：金属外壳与中性点
shots.scene: 变压器中性点连到接地极的示意图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a transformer whose neutral point is connected to a ground rod. No people.
shots.narration: 或把供电系统的中性点接地。

shots.scene: 镀锌铁接地极和扁铁图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a galvanized iron ground rod and a flat galvanized iron strip. No people.
shots.narration: 接地材料，多用镀锌铁。

shots.section_title: 漏电和短路电流有处去
shots.scene: 设备漏电，电流沿接地线顺利流走
shots.prompt_en: Leakage current from an instrument flows smoothly away through the ground wire. No people.
shots.narration: 有了接地，漏电流有路可走。
overlay: 漏电和短路电流有处去

shots.section_title: 漏电和短路电流有处去
shots.scene: 短路瞬间大电流沿接地线入地，设备完好
shots.prompt_en: At the moment of a short circuit, a large current runs through the ground wire into the earth and the instrument stays intact. No people.
shots.narration: 短路时电流流进零电位的大地，

shots.section_title: 漏电和短路电流有处去
shots.scene: 盾牌护住设备和线路图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield protecting an instrument and its wiring. No people.
shots.narration: 保护系统和设备不被损坏。

shots.section_title: 作用一：给漏电流开条路
shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着五个点的空白卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with five dots.
shots.narration: 接地有五个作用。
overlay: 作用一：给漏电流开条路

shots.section_title: 作用一：给漏电流开条路
shots.scene: 两条路：一条经人形，一条经接地线，电流选了接地线
shots.prompt_en: Two paths for leakage current: one through a person pictogram and one through a ground wire; the current takes the ground wire. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，给漏电流另开一条入地的路。

shots.scene: 人形图标触碰仪器外壳，安然无恙，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram touches an instrument case and stays safe, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，减少触电，保护人的生命。

shots.scene: 高楼顶上的避雷针，闪电击中后沿引下线入地
shots.prompt_en: A lightning rod on top of a tall building; lightning strikes it and travels down a conductor into the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，高楼防雷也要靠接地。

shots.section_title: 作用四：泄放雷电和短路电流
shots.scene: 雷电流和短路电流两个箭头都流向接地极
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows, one from lightning and one from a short circuit, both flow into a ground rod. No people.
shots.narration: 第四，雷电流、短路电流安全泄放。
overlay: 作用四：泄放雷电和短路电流

shots.section_title: 作用五：电子设备工作更稳
shots.scene: 精密仪器屏幕上的杂乱波形变得平稳
shots.prompt_en: A noisy waveform on a precision instrument screen becomes smooth and stable. No people.
shots.narration: 第五，让精密电子设备工作更稳。
overlay: 作用五：电子设备工作更稳

shots.scene: 示意图：变压器经相线给设备供电，设备外壳漏电
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a transformer supplies an instrument through a live wire, and the instrument case leaks current. No people.
shots.narration: 看对比：设备没接地，外壳漏电，

shots.scene: 人形图标摸外壳，红色电流穿过身体到地面
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram touches the case, and red current arrows pass through the body down to the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 人一碰，电流就从人身上走。

shots.scene: 人形图标周围闪电，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Lightning bolts around the person pictogram, with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是触电。

shots.scene: 同样的示意图，外壳多了一根接地线
shots.prompt_en: The same diagram, but the instrument case now has a ground wire to a ground rod. No people.
shots.narration: 设备接了地，外壳照样漏电，

shots.scene: 电流沿接地线流走，人形图标安全
shots.prompt_en: Current arrows flow away through the ground wire, and the person pictogram touching the case stays safe. No people.
shots.narration: 电流沿接地线走，人就安全得多。

shots.scene: 人形图标摸着外壳，旁边盾牌打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram touching the instrument case with a shield and a green check beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 人碰外壳，也不会触电。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在接地示意图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a diagram of an instrument connected to a ground rod.
shots.narration: 接地，就是给漏电找条安全的路。

shots.scene: 人形、楼房避雷针、精密仪器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a safe person pictogram, a building with a lightning rod and a precision instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 护人、防雷、护设备，都离不开它。

shots.scene: 没接地触电与接地后安全的两幅对比图标
shots.prompt_en: Two side-by-side icons: an ungrounded case shocking a person pictogram with a red X, and a grounded case with a safe person and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 没接地电走人身，有接地电走地线。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰站在修好的烘箱旁一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye beside the repaired oven.
shots.narration: 接好地，用好电，下次见！
